name: Avride
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Autonomous goods delivery
about: Yandex-spinout building delivery robots + robotaxis; Uber partner
deployment: Commercial robotaxi service on Uber in Dallas since December 2025, covering roughly nine square miles across Downtown, Uptown, Turtle Creek and Deep Ellum, with a safety specialist aboard and fully driverless operation stated as the intent rather than the practice. Delivery robots run on US campuses alongside them.

sources.title: Uber and Avride launch robotaxi rides in Dallas
